_note: Workstream D — the heaviest deck. Full arc: synthetic data -> evolution loop 41->84% -> live viz integration -> demo freeze. Play via village.html?cards=phase_cards.d.json

cards.subtitle: No users yet, so we fabricate a believable town.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · LABELS MUST MATCH REAL BASE-RATE

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Spinning up 300 synthetic personas — role, path, what they seek.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Profiling each one so they look like real Kindred users.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Pairing them up — 250 candidate connections to label.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Label honestly: same-topic pairs should land ~41%, not more.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Calibrated. Base-rate locked so the loop has room to climb.

script.speaker: actian
script.text: Vectors + labels written to the store. Cohort is ready.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Held-out split reserved — 60 pairs the loop never sees.

cards.subtitle: Fit weights on outcomes, measure where we start.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Gen 0 ranks purely on shared topic. Scoring the cohort.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Connection-rate on held-out: 41%. That's our floor.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Told you — topic is a weak signal. Refit on trajectory.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Weighting shared path + what they're seeking now.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Re-ranking with the new weights — topic clumps loosening.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: New top pairs share a path, not just a subject.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Generation 0 logged. Roll the loop forward.

cards.subtitle: Six generations folding in what actually landed.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Re-scored held-out each generation with the fine-tuned model.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Refitting weights on every new landing outcome.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Rate climbing: 41 -> 58 -> 71 -> 84% by generation 5.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Graph re-clustering live — domain clumps fully dissolved.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Promoting generation-5 weights as the new default.

cards.subtitle: Every agent's real events streaming into one village.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Opening the SSE stream — backend, loop and graph all emit here.

script.speaker: band
script.text: Intro-thread events flowing in on the same channel.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Careful — graph re-layout and my events can race.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: One clock drives all panes now. No more races.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Reasoning strings show under each node as it's argued.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Village is live-wired to the real system. Glue holds.

cards.subtitle: Record a frame-exact replay so nothing can break on stage.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Capturing run.json — every event, in order, timestamped.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Replay reproduces the 41 -> 84% climb frame-for-frame.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Live mode stays one keypress away if the wifi behaves.

script.speaker: band
script.text: Feature freeze. Nothing new touches the demo path.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Deck's locked. Kindred's ready to argue in front of judges.
